messages.subject: Negative SEs set to NaN.
parts:
Greeting

Can i ignore this warning?

Calculating information matrix...  
Warning message:                   
Negative SEs set to NaN.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Negative SEs set to NaN.
parts:
I wouldn't. This is a good indication that the model does not have enough data (hence, the ACOV matrix is not positive definite). Interpret the results with caution. 

Phil
